title: Conditional κ = 0.001291474845253222: retimed kernel and reordered R715 deliveries
body:
Conditional **kappa = 0.001291474845253222**, exactly `645737422626611/500000000000000000`, **0.14081141475329892% above this PR's initial result** and 0.16999595% above #467. The bit side binds; the complex supplier remains unchanged #458.

The final construction reconstructs #467, replaces its kernel while retaining its timing/mixing (105 pivots, entrance rank113,104 donors), then applies20 delivery gate-frame moves with stable independent-gate reordering and14 connected-pair retimings. Every intermediate word hash is bound. All280 noncommuting B-gate order constraints are retained. Eight replicas, each residual wholly assigned to one physical family. No cross-family splitting is used.

The new package is `research/r715-reordered-deliveries/`. The earlier `r715-retimed-kernel-pool` package and its validation are preserved. The draft and subsequent witness were submitted before full verification as requested.

New source reconstruction, official legality/formal columns,963 frame projectors,3401 nested/reflected pairs,11 residual isometries,1320 routes and all62,920 whole residual assignments pass. Independent replay checks1,720,752 emitted events and rejects22 operator mutations. Both rational moment engines and47 strict outer inequalities pass. The freshly recomputed807-bit physical prefix is charged832;2477-bit three-level coefficient is charged2496; complete row coefficient19431<20161. Initial evidence: `research/r715-reordered-deliveries-validation/physical311/`.

Complete changed-component wrappers for the final delivery word now pass on Python3.11.15 and3.14.8, each bound to a completed full complex-supplier receipt. Receipts and stage logs are published under `research/r715-reordered-deliveries-validation/python311/` and `python314/`. A fresh default full Python3.11 replay is running; GitHub CI is separate and is not claimed passed. The previous kernel-only word has complete3.11/3.14 component receipts with fully verified complex-supplier reuse, and its fresh default full Python3.14 replay has now passed (`PASS_FULL_R715_REKERNEL_COMPOSITION`), with receipt and logs in `research/r715-retimed-kernel-pool-validation/python314-full/`. This validates the earlier word; the final delivery word has its own checks and running full replay as described above. Each status distinguishes completed-parent reuse from a default full replay. Run `python -B research/r715-reordered-deliveries/verify.py /absolute/new/output` for the final word.

All inherited compiler, target-label/mutable-basis, complete-call correlated-dirty-hosting, compressed-window, restored-work, precision, row and analytic contracts remain. Conditional finite construction; not an unconditional multiplication theorem or global optimum.

Credits: DreamingOfClouds for R715 and target mixing; chafreaky for the shared-donor mechanism and #458 complex supplier; DaysSky for whole hosting; ahrazzle #469 for the local delivery-reordering idea, independently implemented here without its hosting/supplier construction. All inherited authors/licenses retained. New search, witness and verification by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance.

Further research (not an admitted bound): `research/r715-reordered-deliveries-validation/kernel-frontier/` retains six exact local/moment screens, including a101-pivot/rank122 candidate projected near0.0012918924074286004. Fresh physical replay and finite invoice for that candidate remain pending. Losing thirteen-stage screens and the infeasible nine-stage solver instance are retained under `stage-count-screens/`; the headline bound above is unchanged.
